keyword: is artemis landing on the moon

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission launched in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '6:36 PM / April 1, 2026 Artemis II lifts off'; R3: 'blasted off ... on Wednesday evening ... at 6:35 p.m. Eastern time' (April 1, 2026 context)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm launch on April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will not land on the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis crew will not land on the moon'; R2: 'Why NASA’s Artemis II Astronauts Won’t Land on the Moon'; R3: 'around the moon but not land there'; R4: 'won't land on the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state no landing for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will fly around the moon to test systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'loop around it ... thoroughly test their Orion capsule'; R3: 'swing around, passing over the far side'; R4: 'circle it'; R5: 'fly around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm flyby/loop around moon for testing Orion/systems.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is a crewed 10-day test flight.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will orbit the Moon.

verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state no lunar orbit, only flyby/loop.
